sections.heading: Your first Essence
sections.body: The Training Area reward is an unbound Essence item. Unbound Essences live in your inventory until you absorb them into the Soul Archive.

sections.heading: What to do
sections.body: Open the Absorb tab, select the unbound Essence, and press Absorb. Once absorbed, it becomes part of your character instead of a loose inventory item.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.body: Absorbed Essences can be attuned in a loadout. Attuned Essences provide active and passive combat abilities, making this one of your main build systems.
